name: Home Away From Home
description: An evening celebrating Burmese culture — food, conversation, and community. Meet fellow Burmese students, and hear from representatives of the Embassy of Myanmar in Ottawa on consular services, including passport renewal.

name: Thingyan Festival
description: Myanmar New Year celebration with traditional performances, Thingyan music, delicious Burmese food, and raffle draws. Hosted by the Burmese Canadian Association of Ontario (BCAO); promoted by MCC UofT.

name: Origami Workshop
description: UTFOLD and MCC present a Burmese-inspired origami workshop — a cozy evening of folding, snacks, and learning about Burmese culture. No experience needed.

name: New Year's Condo Party
description: Kickstart 2026 with MCC's New Year party — open bar with Burmese-inspired cocktails, snacks, games, and karaoke.

name: Burmese Language Workshop
description: A Burmese language workshop for all levels, beginner to advanced — learn the alphabet, writing, and useful phrases.

name: Back to School Picnic
description: MCC's first event of the school year — an afternoon picnic to meet the execs and make new friends in the Burmese community. Light refreshments provided.

name: Roll & Shuffle with MCC
location: Snakes & Lattes Annex, 600 Bloor St W
description: An afternoon of board games with MCC — free to attend, open to UofT students from all three campuses.

name: An Intercultural Adventure
description: MCC × UTChinese Network Student Association collab — snacks and fun games together.

name: An MCC Pub Night
location: Duke of York Pub, 39 Prince Arthur Ave
description: A holiday MCC pub night — mingling with friends and delicious platters on MCC.

name: MCC Mixer
description: MCC's first ever mixer — a night of food, music, and fun. Free to attend.

name: A Sweet Taste of Myanmar & China
description: Free desserts and tea, hosted by MCC in collaboration with the UTChinese Network Student Association.

name: A Savoury Taste of Myanmar: Ohn No Khao Swe
description: MCC shared Ohn No Khao Swe, a Burmese coconut noodle soup, sponsored by the Centre for International Experience (CIE).

name: Multicultural Munch
description: MCC joined four other clubs sharing cultural foods, serving the Burmese dessert Shwe Yin Aye.

name: Mahādhammika Myanmar Buddhist Temple Visit
location: Mahādhammika Myanmar Buddhist Temple, North York, ON
description: A free trip to learn about Buddhism, practice guided meditation with a monk, and enjoy a Burmese lunch. Bus transportation provided.

name: "Hi Hi": UTCN × MCC Culture Exchange
description: Cross-ethnic networking session with Myanmar and Chinese culture trivia, a Myanmar makeup feature, and food and tea tasting. Co-hosted with UTChinese Network.

name: Multicultural Bazaar: Food Giveaway
description: MCC gave away traditional Burmese food — Ei Kyar Kway (deep-fried dough snack) and Laphat Yay (Burmese milk tea) — at the Multicultural Bazaar.
